text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks for inviting me out<n>here. I needed a
break.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've had so much on my mind<n>recently that it's
been affecting my<n>performance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Things like the most effective way to<n>prepare for
my next race or if I'm<n>working hard enough on my
winning<n>equation...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of equations, I wonder if<n>Ticket was able
to use the one I<n>taught her the other day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And where's that Taishin? I haven't<n>seen her this
morning. Oh, I hope she<n>isn't laid up in bed because
she<n>overworked herself!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Anxious as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If you think I'm playing hooky, I'm<n>not. I'm just
taking a breather before<n>the student council meeting
starts.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. We came here to<n>take a break
too.
choice_data_list: Why don't we all pay a visit to the shrine together?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That would be wonder—oh, but Brian<n>has a meeting
soon. Maybe we<n>shouldn't bother her...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's no skin off my back. I still have<n>time before I
have to go.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thanks so much, you two.<n>This will be a
nice little break.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The three of us pray at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What's so funny?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nothing... Praying here with you just<n>reminds me of
that one time when we<n>were younger.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What did you pray for this year,<n>Brian?

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
I prayed to become as fast as you!<n>What'd you
pray for?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I prayed that we'll always be<n>able to race
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That was forever ago. I don't<n>remember anything
like that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I still remember like it was<n>yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was. I'm glad I was able to<n>remember my wish
too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're so simple sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems that with this little outing,<n>Biwa Hayahide
is feeling better than<n>ever!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... This is no good. The more I try<n>not to think
about it, the more I do!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't waste your breath. There's no<n>stopping her
once she starts spiraling.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian! I worry about you too, you<n>know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I constantly worry about how you're<n>doing in
school and if you're eating<n>and resting properl—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Don't you run away! You come<n>back here and
listen to me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm not trying to run away! I have a<n>student council
meeting, remember?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This shrine visit doesn't end up<n>helping Biwa
Hayahide relax at all...
